# splitsecure_group_member (Resource)

One member of a locally-managed group. Import with group_s2r/member, where both are full s2rs. SCIM and system groups are refused.

Choosing a resource: this resource is additive. It adds and removes only its own member and leaves every other member alone. Use the members attribute of splitsecure_group instead to own the whole member set. Never use both on the same group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The group leaves members unset, so other members added in the
# console stay. Terraform adds and removes only this one.
resource "splitsecure_group" "on_call" {
  name = "On-call"
}

# A service account, by its own address.
data "splitsecure_principal" "deploy_bot" {
  email = var.deploy_bot_address
}

resource "splitsecure_group_member" "deploy_bot" {
  group_s2r = splitsecure_group.on_call.group_s2r
  member    = data.splitsecure_principal.deploy_bot.s2r
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_s2r` (String) Group s2r URI. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `member` (String) S2r URI of the user or service account to add. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Member id in the form group_s2r/member.
